Lemma
[Blow-up of the maximal scalar curvature integral] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0227 1. Lemma 6.59\group normalized-ricci-flow

For a three-dimensional Ricci flow with initially positive Ricci curvature and maximal existence time $T<\infty $, one has \[ \int _0^T R_{\max }(t)\, dt=\infty . \]
